added.summary: A new game's ui choice is one of the engine's themes (anime, candy, cartoon, fantasy, ink, minimal, pixel, scifi, storybook, tactical) or default, labelled in English and Chinese, each with its preview. A look's preset names its theme in its ui line and the catalogue's ui does the same (toy-3d candy, painterly-3d fantasy, neon-vector scifi …), so a game made from a look starts in its theme.

`og api show themes`: the engine's themes and what each fits, picking one in the look, deriving the game's own theme.json with extends, replacing a piece of drawn art by hand, and the contrast the cook guarantees.
